card.name: Words just before CNS drug names
card.fires_on: Small words such as "of" or word starts such as "n", "an" and "ne" that come right before a centrally acting drug name or neuro term, such as naltrexone, guanfacine, baclofen, or neuropeptides.

modes.label: Linking word before drug
modes.description: The word "of" after a dose or administration phrase, just before a nerve- or brain-acting drug name.

modes.label: Inside a drug or neuro name
modes.description: The opening piece of a drug or neuro term, when the rest of the name is about to follow.
